name: Christopher Pearson
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Christopher Pearson as an author of “The national deformation model and New Zealand's plate boundary zone”.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Chris Pearson as an author of “Dynamic datums in GIS through modern GNSS positioning”.
The University of Otago profile identifies the geodesy researcher as Chris Pearson; the conference record uses Christopher Pearson for the dynamic-datum contribution.
